title.zh: 将巴拉望省Cuyo市镇Cuyo区医院床位由50张增至75张并为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Increasing the Bed Capacity of the Cuyo District Hospital in the Municipality of Cuyo, Province of Palawan, From Fifty (50) To Seventy-five (75) Beds, and Appropriating Funds Therefore
title.orig: An Act Increasing the Bed Capacity of the Cuyo District Hospital in the Municipality of Cuyo, Province of Palawan, From Fifty (50) To Seventy-five (75) Beds, and Appropriating Funds Therefore

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1992/ra_7599_1992.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The bed capacity of the Cuto District Hospital in the Municipality of Cuyo, Province of Palawan, is hereby increased from fifty 50) to seventy-five (75) beds.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following is enactment into law thereafter.
This Act shall effect upon its approval.
